observations: Storyboard shot 1 drew NORA as an elderly bearded man; the final drew her as an elderly woman. The same character changed between the rough cut and the final.
TEO, the grandson, was cast with ageRange 'adult' and drawn from behind as an adult.
The stand-in crew cast every character with appearance 'As the script describes <NAME>.', so no description reached the image or video prompt.
The final used Kling text-to-video: the approved storyboard still was not the first frame, so nothing tied the final to what the creator approved.
otherFindings: The final is 3.5 seconds from 10 billed seconds: Kling bills 5 seconds per clip, and the planned shots were 1.5 to 2 seconds.
characterConsistency.followUp: HV-017-05: the stand-in casts from the script's own introductions, and finals start from the approved storyboard still (image-to-video).
